Subtracting 10 weeks and 1 day means subtracting 71 days.  
1138 is not a leap year (divisible by 2 but not by 4).  
October 29, 1138 minus 71 days:  
October has 31 days, so back to September 29 is 30 days earlier (71 - 30 = 41 left).  
September has 30 days, so back to August 30 is 29 days earlier (41 - 29 = 12 left).  
August 30 minus 12 days = August 18, 1138.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1138-08-18
